references.text: The preceding verse describes how Ehud drove the sword into Eglon's belly, which directly leads to the event in verse 22
Saul falls on his own sword in battle - another dramatic death by the sword in the Old Testament
Asahel is killed by Abner with a spear thrust in the belly - similar fatal abdominal wound as Eglon
Amasa is stabbed in the belly by Joab, and his entrails spill out - parallel to Eglon's death with the entrails coming out
Judas' death where his entrails gushed out - similarly gruesome description of death with entrails coming out of the body
